en.title: 3. Set System Scoring (Recurve & Barebow)
en.excerpt: How the 2-1-0 Set System works for individual and team match play in Recurve, Barebow, and Standard Bow divisions.
en.content:
The 2-1-0 Set Point Mechanism

In Recurve and Barebow divisions, matches are decided by Set Points rather than total cumulative arrow scores. This format emphasizes high-pressure consistency across individual ends:

  • Set Winner: The athlete with the higher arrow score in that set receives 2 Set Points.
  • Tied Set: Both athletes receive 1 Set Point each.
  • Set Loser: Receives 0 Set Points.

Individual Set Match Rules (Target: 6 Points)

In individual match play:

  • Each set consists of 3 arrows per athlete.
  • The first athlete to reach 6 Set Points wins the match immediately.
  • Maximum regulation sets: 5 sets (maximum possible score: 6-4, 6-2, 6-0, or 5-5).

Team Set Match Rules (Target: 5 Points)

In team match play (3 archers per team):

  • Each set consists of 6 arrows (2 arrows per archer).
  • The first team to reach 5 Set Points wins the match.

5-5 Sudden Death Shoot-Offs

If the match is tied 5-5 after 5 sets, a single-arrow shoot-off takes place to determine the winner.
